name: openbb_derivatives_futures_historical
description:
Daily price history of a futures contract from Yahoo Finance through the OpenBB Platform (obb.derivatives.futures.historical), in OpenBB's default date window.
Returns: {tool, data_points (total rows), data: first 100 rows as OpenBB returns them} or {tool, error}.
Inputs (* required): symbol* (Yahoo futures symbol, e.g. CL=F, GC=F, SI=F; default CL=F); provider (yfinance only; default yfinance, no key).
Term structure: openbb_derivatives_futures_curve; spot series: fred_oil_price, fred_gold_price. Keys: fmp, benzinga, fred, intrinio, polygon and tiingo need credentials in OpenBB's settings (~/.openbb_platform/user_settings.json), not supplied by SAJHA; yfinance, oecd, federal_reserve, sec, imf and government_us need none.
Example: {"symbol": "GC=F", "provider": "yfinance"}

symbol.description: Yahoo futures symbol, e.g. CL=F, GC=F
